slides.concept: AI瞎编不是坏了，是训练就奖励猜
slides.headline: AI为啥爱瞎编
slides.subtitle: 明明不知道，却答得理直气壮
slides.narration: 你问AI一个它不知道的事，它照样答得有鼻子有眼。OpenAI说这不是程序坏了，是设计。今天五张图讲清楚。
slides.image_prompt: Sketch a confused human asking a question in a chat bubble on the left, and a robot on the right replying with a long confident answer. Draw a small thought bubble above the robot showing a checkmark next to a false fact, with a question mark above the human.

slides.concept: 它学的是接龙流畅，不是判断真假
slides.headline: 它学的不是真假

bullets.title: 预训练
bullets.desc: 预测下一个词，没有对错标签

bullets.title: 奖励机制
bullets.desc: 答得流畅像人话，就算过关

bullets.title: 结果
bullets.desc: 会编故事，不会说不知道

slides.narration: 先看训练目标：AI玩的是文字接龙，猜下一个词该是什么。不像考试有对错，它只看像不像人说话。生日这类零散事实，根本没法从规律里推出来。
slides.image_prompt: Sketch a left-right comparison. Left: human teacher at blackboard writing TRUE and FALSE with a student marking answers. Right: robot reading a sentence with arrows pointing to the next predicted word, labeled as autocomplete. Draw a not-equal sign between truth-checking and next-word prediction.

slides.concept: 瞎猜的模型，排行榜分数反而更高
slides.headline: 猜多的分更高
slides.narration: OpenAI做了SimpleQA测试：老模型几乎每题都答，错75%；新模型52%说不知道，错26%。但只看答对率，瞎猜的老模型反而略高。
slides.image_prompt: Sketch two bar charts side by side comparing two AI models. Left bar chart labeled old model with tall red error bar at 75% and tiny abstention bar at 1%. Right bar chart labeled new model with moderate green accuracy bar at 22% and large gray abstention bar at 52% and smaller red error bar at 26%. Draw an arrow pointing to accuracy metric favoring the left model.

slides.concept: 排行榜像只比答对数的选择题
slides.headline: 蒙比空着划算

bullets.title: 选择题
bullets.desc: 不会的蒙一个，还有1/365机会

bullets.title: 排行榜
bullets.desc: 只比答对几题，不比错几题

slides.narration: 打个比方：AI像在考选择题。问某人生日，猜9月10日有365分之一能对；说不知道必得零分。排行榜只比答对几题，不比错几题，考场上它就宁可编。
slides.image_prompt: Sketch a multiple-choice exam paper with four options A B C D. Draw a student hesitating between guessing randomly and leaving blank. Show probability 1/365 next to a birthday guess. Add a scoreboard at bottom ranking students only by number of correct answers, ignoring wrong answers.

slides.concept: 重要的事别全信，让它标不确定
slides.headline: 猜比诚实得分高

bullets.title: 记住
bullets.desc: 幻觉是奖励机制，不是神秘故障

slides.narration: 一句话：AI瞎编，因为猜比诚实得分高。你要做的：重要的事别全信，让它标出哪里不确定。
slides.image_prompt: Sketch a simple flow: robot at fork in road, left path labeled guess and win points, right path labeled say I don't know and get zero. At bottom draw a human with a checklist: verify important facts, ask for uncertainty labels.
